task.title: P6-057: Add removal and edit affordance for multi-grain cells
task.description:
Migrated from specs/TODO-Phase-6.md (Stage 5 — Missing capability). Original id: P6-057. Size: M. Specs: specs/app-ui.md.

**A multi-grain cell has no removal or edit affordance** (rescoped 2026-07-30 — the move case is already covered). `collection.rs:1439-1459`: the `holding_id = None` branch (several finish/condition/language stacks summed into one rendered row) is plain text with a title attribute, no stepper and no remove, because the row cannot name which stack the control means. The row **is** still selectable (`:1345`), so the selection tray already gives it a move path; what is missing is remove and per-grain edit. Needs the per-grain expansion the spec calls for, or `P6-016`.
